page.title: Diagnostics
page.purpose: Diagnose route reachability from local listener through tunnel ingress to the external URL, with honest probe and metric boundaries.

priorities.statement: Diagnostics follow the route journey from local to edge to public.
A failed signal is classified rather than collapsed into a generic unhealthy state.
Refresh, stale data, manual probe, and retry are visible affordances.

states.description: Metrics and probe history are loading.
Route health, tunnel metrics, and probe history are visible.
Some diagnostic sources are unavailable while other signals remain attributed.
Last known diagnostic data remains visible during refresh.
No probe history exists yet; the page offers a first probe action.
A diagnostic request failed and names the failed source.

claims.statement: Each diagnostic result identifies the stage and source that produced it; unavailable signals are not presented as healthy or failed routes.
